zh-CN.name: 实时监控
zh-CN.description: 持续或定期更新状态与事件的监控界面。所谓实时必须由实际刷新机制、时间戳和数据链路支持；仅有跳动数字或闪烁装饰并不代表实时数据。
use_when: 任务需要及时发现状态变化或异常。
数据来源可提供明确的更新与失效信息。
avoid_when: 不能把模拟或过期数据标为实时。
频繁刷新不应打断阅读、筛选或键盘操作。
zh-CN.prompt_template: 展示状态、最近更新时间和数据连接情况；新事件按优先级提示，过期或断连时明确标注；保留用户当前筛选与阅读位置，提供暂停自动更新或查看事件历史的方式。

en.name: Real-Time Monitoring
en.description: A monitoring interface that updates states and events continuously or at defined intervals. Real-time claims require actual refresh behavior, timestamps and data delivery; animated numbers alone do not establish live data.
use_when: The task requires timely awareness of changes or anomalies.
The data source can communicate update and stale-state information.
avoid_when: Do not label simulated or stale data as live.
Frequent updates must not disrupt reading, filters or keyboard interaction.
en.prompt_template: Show state, last update time and connection health. Prioritize new events and clearly mark stale data or disconnection. Preserve filters and reading position, and offer a way to pause updates or review event history.
